statement: The 2-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman algorithm distinguishes every pair of non-isomorphic finite graphs.
definitions: 2-WL = the 2-dimensional (folklore) Weisfeiler-Leman algorithm: colour ordered vertex pairs (u,v), initial colour = (u==v, uv in E), refinement c'(u,v) = (c(u,v), multiset over all w of (c(u,w), c(w,v))), iterated to stabilisation on both graphs with a shared colour alphabet; 2-WL distinguishes G and H iff the stable colour multisets differ. (Under the oblivious k-tuple convention the same statement is also false.)
